Fairfield County, meet your house's new guardian. 🏡

My House Guardian provides preventative maintenance and upkeep for Fairfield County homes. You get one person who knows your house. Our team comes four times a year to do the jobs most people skip, like filters, alarms, gutters and the dryer vent, and we send you a report of what we observed. Your house, our responsibility.
